info.title: fabPlane API
info.description: Organizations, personal API tokens, shopping carts (BOM with purchase destinations) and team inventory. Errors are `{ error, message? }`. See https://fabplane.com/docs/api.

get.summary: Current principal, email verification state and personal org

post.summary: Create a personal API token (the secret is returned once)

get.summary: List the caller's orgs (creates the personal org on first use)

post.summary: Create an org; the caller becomes its owner

get.summary: Orgs the caller may join through their verified email domain
Get an org the caller belongs to

patch.summary: Rename an org or configure domain join (admin)
patch.description: `domainJoin.domain` must equal the caller's verified email domain; public webmail domains and personal orgs are rejected.

delete.summary: Delete an org and everything in it (owner; not personal orgs)

post.summary: Join an org through its verified email domain

patch.summary: Change a member's role (admin; only owners grant or revoke owner)

409.description: `conflict`: the last owner cannot be demoted

delete.summary: Remove a member (admin), or leave the org (self)

post.summary: Create an invite link (admin). No email is sent.

get.summary: Preview a pending invite by token

post.summary: Accept an invite (single use; email-bound invites need a matching verified email)

get.summary: Built-in purchase destinations followed by the org's custom ones

post.summary: Add a custom purchase destination (admin), e.g. DigiKey Thailand

delete.summary: Delete a custom destination (admin); its cart items fall back to builtin:manual

post.summary: Start connecting an agent as a bot member (device-code style)
post.description: Anonymous and rate limited. Show `verificationUriComplete` to a human org admin, then poll pollBotConnect.

401.description: `invalid_client`: clientId is not a first-party client

post.summary: Poll for the bot token (issued once, after approval)

200.description: The bot token (only on the first poll after approval)

get.summary: Show a pending bot connect request and the orgs you can approve it into

200.description: The request and your admin orgs

post.summary: Approve a bot into an org you administer (personal orgs allowed)
Deny a bot connect request
Create a bot directly (admin); the token is shown once
Issue a new bot token and revoke the previous ones (admin)

delete.summary: Remove a bot and revoke its tokens (admin)

get.summary: List carts; filter by tagged repo (normalized) or client project id

post.summary: Create a cart (shopping list / BOM)

get.summary: Get a cart with its items grouped by destination

post.summary: Move a cart to another org the caller belongs to

200.description: The cart in its new org

post.summary: Append items; items without destinationId follow the cart's fab destination

get.summary: Export the cart as CSV, optionally for one destination
get.description: Columns: destination (name), kind (item kind), mpn, manufacturer, description, refs (comma-joined), quantity, sku, url, unitPrice, currency, status, notes.

post.summary: Add an item (JSON, or multipart with `item` JSON and `image` files); upserts by externalId

200.description: Updated the item with the same (source, externalId)

503.description: `storage_unavailable`: images were sent but object storage is not configured

post.summary: Create or update up to 500 items, matched by (source, externalId)

200.description: The upserted items in input order

get.summary: Items still waiting for a product photo, with queue counts
get.description: `include=available` (default) lists claimable items: no images, status queued, lease absent or expired. `include=all` lists every imageless item, including leased and skipped ones. Ordered by attempts, then age.

post.summary: Lease available items for a photo-search worker
post.description: Atomic (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED): concurrent claims never return the same item. Increments attempts; fewest attempts, then oldest, first.

200.description: The leased items (possibly empty) and the lease expiry

post.summary: Give an item back: retry later, or mark that no photo was found
post.description: `retry` clears the lease and keeps the item queued. `not_found` marks it skipped (it leaves the queue) and stores the note. Workers pass the `leaseToken` from their claim; without it only an unleased item can be released. 409 `conflict` when the item is leased under a different token (the lease expired and another worker reclaimed it).

409.description: `conflict`: leased by another worker (or the token no longer matches)

post.summary: Put a skipped item back in the queue with zero attempts (admin)

patch.summary: Update fields of an inventory item

409.description: `conflict`: another item already has this (source, externalId)

delete.summary: Delete an item and its images

post.summary: Atomically add to or take from the quantity

409.description: `conflict`: the quantity would drop below zero

post.summary: Upload a photo (multipart `image`, or a raw image body)

source.description: Where the photo came from, e.g. user or web

sourceUrl.description: http(s) page the photo was found on

get.summary: Redirect to a 15-minute signed image URL

bearerAuth.description: `fpk_…` personal API token or `fpd_…` device token
